name: XDKNet 3.0.3.4
body:
XDKNet 3.0.3.4 fixes live TV in the web app. Update the server plugin to
3.0.3.4 along with the app.

## Fixed

- Live channels in the web app no longer keep reconnecting. The web player
  asked the server to re-encode the picture of most 1080p channels, which a
  live 60 fps channel can't keep up with. Now the server only repackages the
  stream and converts the sound when the browser needs it.

TVs on 2.4.10 or later offer this update on their own. On 2.4.9, use
Settings > About > Check for updates. Anything older has to install it once
by hand, from the Android TV APK below.
